name: Grandma Rosa's and Nana Bea's cards

recipes.title: Cinnamon Crumb Coffee Cake
steps: Add the oleo, egg, milk and vanilla. Spread in a greased 8-inch square pan.
For the topping, cut the cold butter into the brown sugar, flour and cinnamon until crumbly, and add the nuts. Sprinkle the topping over.
Bake in a moderate oven (350°F) 35–40 minutes.
recipes.notes: Oleo is margarine; melted butter works the same.

recipes.title: Refrigerator Rolls
steps: Dissolve the yeast in the lukewarm water.
Cream the shortening and sugar, and beat in the egg and salt.
Add the yeast and enough flour to make a soft dough. Cover and keep in the icebox overnight.
Shape into rolls and set them in a greased pan. Let rise until double, about 1 hr.
Brush with melted butter and bake in a hot oven (400°F) 12–15 minutes.
recipes.notes: Nana made the dough the night before Thanksgiving and baked the rolls while the turkey rested.
recipes.unsure: The oven temperature is smudged; 400°F fits rolls like these.
